learned_from: ChatEval (the blind 4-lane A/B/C/D race, judged by the 120b): the 120b = #1 in 3/3 asks; phi4-mini = #2 in 3/3; the qwen-7b = the vague/generic on the chat-asks (the judge's words) - the CODER-tuned = for code-only; the deepseek-r1 = the slow-reasoning (the 4th)
law: THE STRENGTH LAW (2026-11-04): a hand-off chain may only KEEP or RAISE model strength (the same weights on another provider, or a STRONGER model) - never silently drop to a weaker one; the ONLY weaker fallback = the founder's documented OFFLINE floor (the chat lane's phi4-mini, disclosed in SYSTEM_IDENTITY). The routes = the DATA (the eval-refresh rewrites them); the pool-vocab = CloudBrain's; the RAM-law: the ollama = the single-slot auto-swap (one model loaded at a time); $0.00 all-lanes
